title: trifolium filiforme var. dubium
intro: Trifolium filiforme var. dubium, commonly known as the "tall white clover," is a plant species belonging to the legume family. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties that can aid in the treatment of various conditions such as wounds, gastrointestinal issues, and fever. The therapeutic actions of Trifolium filiforme var. dubium include its ability to promote wound healing, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily isoflavones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
